**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Nina](../persons.html#2352)[^1]
[Gertrude](../persons.html#1462) desires me to say that we have never had an American edition of [the Three Brides](../books.html#120) but she has taken measures for getting a second hand one and it will be sent to you.

All my stories in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) do get published again	Gertrude is tolerably well just now

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Identified tentatively from the letter of 2 June 1883.
